fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready: cycle close 2026-10-25
fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-10-24 11:30 to 2026-10-25 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: four open escalations, all proposed in the group log, none new from this run.
- bf4a5af5 (srs-rust#1264, filed 10-22, about 83h): how do structured diagnostics reach the existing text lists? Why it matters: every reader of those lists (srs-web, srs-vscode, scripts, MCP clients) breaks on the day the new build is pinned. Options: (A) replace everywhere in one release; (B) add a structured list beside the text one, retire the text later; (C) code on validation results first, other surfaces later; (D) nothing. Recommendation: C first, then B. Action needed: decide. Urgency: medium; your c7fefad9 ruling made this the next blocker, and srs-rust#1339 waits behind it.
- 01cfb06e (srs-rust#1342, revised with you 10-24): type ErrorReport.details only for the codes clients act on. Why it matters: clients hand-write error types today. Recommendation: the narrow mirror (option d). Action needed: decide. Urgency: low, no consumer blocked.
- 6b5e2810 (srs#931, filed 10-24): may an RFC reopen RFC-039's retired field-id bridge? Why it matters: a name is not a stable identity, so srs-web#547 and board columns can collide on shared field names; the fix changes accepted normative meaning, which is outside the builder's mandate. Options: (A) expose fieldId beside name; (B) a separate resolution read; (C) do nothing. Recommendation: authorise an RFC weighing A against B. Action needed: decide. Urgency: low (srs-web#547 can ship by name meanwhile).
- 444121a6 (srs#911, filed 10-25): how a rendered document starts below its title. Why it matters: a broken heading outline hurts accessibility and agents that navigate by headings. Options: (a) allow a negative depthOffset; (b) first rendered level follows the title; (c) keep working around it. Recommendation: open an RFC (Door 2) weighing a against b. Action needed: decide. Urgency: low.
Also waiting on you: exercise dd1a47a7 (relation reads and createdBy, srs-rust#1411; recommendation yes, additive) and exercise 2ac083c0 (one unknown key makes a repository unloadable). needs-input with no ruling yet: srs-rust#861, #683, #1198, #1132, #1380, srs#928. Label step: srs#236 still carries needs-input although b80d2d1e is now ratified; srs-rust#1264 still carries needs-input after your c7fefad9 ruling.

2. Decided within mandate: nothing ratified by the group this cycle; no merged PR named a proposed decision as assent, so no group session was needed. Owner rulings now ratified in both logs (group log and SemanticOps decision log): c7fefad9 "Diagnostics shape before srs-rust#1339", bbb03bff "srs-rust#1417 (RFC-052) how to land the root-container move", b80d2d1e (naming rule, srs#236), 04b78189 (one filename slug scheme, srs-rust#1209; its convention is now in force and the proving period runs from the srs-rust#1405 merge).

3. Done: 4 PRs merged.
- srs-rust#1462 (deleting a container unlinks it from parents, #1442): agent:tpr-builder / agent:tpr-reviewer / mandate RFC-034 [R7], I-150; approve on green 99c5a48; gate:auto-merge, 13:02.
- srs-web#615 (align CreateRelationInput with relation.json): agent:tpr-builder / agent:tpr-reviewer / mandate 00567bf1; approve on green 84dceb9; gate:auto-merge, 14:37.
- srs-rust#1463 (RFC-051, dataModelRevision 11): human:the-greenman / agent:local-challenger / mandate RFC-051 Rev 15 + a8e833f1; approve on green 52931c3 after two rejects; gate:owner-merge, 14:54. Release-candidate check: GO.
- srs-rust#1467 (validate childContainerIds, I-150): agent:tpr-builder / agent:tpr-reviewer / mandate 00567bf1/RFC-034 [R7]/I-150; approve on green 9f10cec; gate:auto-merge, 16:13.

4. Stuck or lost: two group PRs open. srs-rust#1465 (refuse a type write that orphans records, #1412): reviewer approved on green 5d4b946 on 10-24, but the branch is behind base and not merged; the owner's 10-25 note says srs-rust#1473 (new version beside the old, owner-approved) lands next and the two do not conflict. srs-rust#1469 (composition shown-in query): reviewer rejected on red check-schema-drift (ca722cb, mirror drift from the RFC-051 schema change); nothing to merge until the builder syncs the mirror. Every merged PR has a quorum line with findings; srs-rust#1463's quorum comments are by the local challenger, not the cloud reviewer. No claims to release. needs-input: srs-rust#861, #683, #1198, #1132, #1264, #1339, #1342, #1380, srs#236, #911, #928, #931.

5. Budget: 3 of 10 delegated merges this cycle (srs-rust#1463 was owner-merge and does not count); 2 open. Pause state: running (the 10-24 report carries your thumbs-up). clerk group-state reads 0 merged because this run started after the 11:30 roll-over; the figure here is counted from the PRs.
5b. Awaiting ratification: bf4a5af5 (about 83h), 01cfb06e (about 69h), 6b5e2810 (about 16h), 444121a6 (about 4h). These were still in lifecycle draft, which hides them from the session agenda; this run moved bf4a5af5, 01cfb06e and 6b5e2810 to proposed. Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready and workable: 0. Every issue labelled ready is also needs-input or parked. Workable without the label and by the Builder's order: srs-rust#1412 (P2, PR #1465), srs-rust#1473 (P1, owner-approved), srs-rust#1378 (PR #1469). No local priorities set. Open group PRs in flight: 2. Budget left: 7. **Queue running dry: 0 ready, budget 10. Needs feeding.** Your rulings on bf4a5af5 and 01cfb06e release srs-rust#1264, then #1339 and #1342; after that, the analyst's nominations and the drift list. Waiting on you: section 1. Fed by the analyst: 2026-10-23 12:15 run: filed 1, nominated 3; no run since.

6b. Exercises: two open, both the group's own (not in the SemanticOps log): dd1a47a7 "Relation reads hide who asserted a link", input asked for: should relation list and context reads carry createdBy, notes and meta (srs-rust#1411); 2ac083c0 "One unknown key makes a whole repository unloadable", input asked for: non-fatal diagnostic or fail-closed with the LOAD verb narrowed to meta.

7. What we learned: the proposal-in-draft gap recurred (three escalations sat hidden from the session agenda, one for 83h), so the filing step should transition to proposed itself. A reviewer verdict of reject on red CI after a spec merge (srs-rust#1469) is the schema-mirror drift pattern again: any PR open when a schema-changing PR merges goes red by construction, so the builder should sync the mirror before requesting review. Build trigger: ratified decisions across both logs are well over 10, so srs-web#560 (decision-log lens) is still ready to unpark; flagged again.
fieldValues.rationale: No new escalation was raised: every item outside the boundary (srs-rust#1264, #1342, srs#931, srs#911) is already open as a proposed decision, so no second record was filed. Three of them were moved from draft to proposed so the ratify agenda can see them. No decision had reviewer assent on a merged PR, so nothing was ratified.
